notes.title: Corrections and optimizations
notes.content:
#Bug fixing

- Correction of internal problems in some phases.

- Game optimization

#Localization:

Correction and optimization of translated text
Addition of fallback fonts.

This update had a lot of help from Iwan Gabovitch, thank you!
